summary: The rendered output captures the main structure and much of the tabular data, but it has major issues in the top-right identifier section and misses the visible certifier signature mark in the table. The source also contains a handwritten date in the checked-by area that is not represented.
matches_well: The overall document type and logical structure are preserved: header, owner information, photograph/thumb-impression placeholders, land details table, totals, and bottom signature areas are represented.
The coat of arms, photograph, thumb impressions, official stamp, and signatures are appropriately replaced with placeholder boxes or labels in most locations.
Most main owner details, address fields, citizenship information, issued date, issued office, and the three land-record table rows are represented in a sensible order.
The total area value is numerically consistent with the source.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source shows an upper identifier “PF002728503” in the top-right area, which is not present in the rendered output.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The rendered output shows only one identifier, labeled “Land Ownership Certificate No.: NM0000095”.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source lower identifier appears as “NM0000091”, not “NM0000095”.

discrepancies.location: rightmost column of land details table / certifier signature area
discrepancies.source_observation: The source contains a large red handwritten signature/mark across the rightmost certifier signature column.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The “Signature of the certifier” column is blank.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source shows the checked-by signature area with an additional handwritten date below the signature, which is not captured in the rendered output.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The rendered output shows “Checked by: (Signed)” only.
